practice.scope: Fully visible artificial scenes establish current-host choices, guard precedence and runtime; no competitive inference.

recovery.scope: Actual-tick lane healing, useful shopping and bounded escape. Local mechanism only.

openings.scope: Actual first opening command, all ten classes/two teams/five ordinals. Both sources tested against prospective expectations; not competitive evidence.

buyback.scope: Actual buyback cost/spawn resources/charges/cooldown preservation and non-spending guards, both colors/all classes. Baseline checked against its own unchanged expected behavior; not competitive evidence.

portals.scope: Deterministic actual-tick fixtures; direct world manipulations test mechanics and guards, not competitive strength.

scenarios.scope: All ten classes on both colors: real host upgrades, shop, portal guards, death/buyback, 600-creep stress; both-color finite defense release, observed-hit fractional movement and fog exclusion.
